author: Inside Edition
description: Former fiancé of Donald Trump Jr., Kimberly Guilfoyle, whom the president handpicked to serve as ambassador to Greece, reportedly asked Trump donor, Eric Deter, who once ran for governor of Kentucky, to help pay her $100,000 American Express bill in exchange for helping connect Deters with the new Trump administration. When he did not pay, Deters says she ghosted him. Guilfoyle disputes the authenticity of the messages.
title: The Ex-Girlfriend of Donald Trump Jr. Allegedly Asked Trump Donor To Pay Her $100K Bill

author: Inside Edition
description: Authorities have released bodycam video from a 2023 school shooting in which a 6-year-old boy opened fire in his classroom. Teacher Abby Zwerner was severely injured, but survived. The unsealed video shows the boy cursing at cops and another instructor. Inside Edition's Alison Hall has the details.
title: Bodycam Video Captures Profane Outburst From 6-Year-Old School Shooter

author: Inside Edition
description: The woman known as Jane Doe, who filed a civil lawsuit against Cornell University and seven fraternity brothers alleging the men raped her, says she is getting threats. According to her attorney, the threats arrived via texts and phone calls.  Most recently, she and her family were “swatted” by a call to police saying there was a gunfight at the family’s home, the woman’s attorney told CNN. None of the seven men have been criminally charged in the alleged rape and they deny any wrongdoing.
title: Jane Doe In Alleged Cornell Assault Says She Is Getting Death Threats

author: Inside Edition
description: Two people sued Hershey's claiming they were tricked by this treat! The lawsuit was filed in Florida, where two plaintiffs say they purchased halloween-themed, pumpkin-shaped Reese's peanut butter candies. They claimed they were expecting the jack-o-lantern style design as shown on the package. When they opened up their candy, they alleged they found no carve outs, only a pumpkin-shaped, chocolate covered treat. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: The Surprising Reason Reese's Peanut Butter Pumpkins Have New Package Disclaimer This Halloween

author: Inside Edition
description: Was this dog looking for a job as a new K-9 recruit for the Tampa Police Department, or was it just lost? On September 30, a dog wandered to a Tampa, Florida police station after getting loose from its home. After a quick trip to the vet and a scan of the dog's internal chip, the owner was found and the dog was returned. The Tampa Police Department released footage of the wonderful reunion.
title: Lost Dog Wanders To Police Station For Help

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman took herself on a dizzying daytime ride that landed her behind bars. The Jennings County Sheriff's Office in Indiana posted video of her car speeding in circles on the lawn of a courthouse. They say it was being operated by a 68 year-old woman who was intoxicated. It's unclear what prompted the doughnuts and the unwise choice of location. The sheriff's office posted the video to social media with some sage advice. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Woman Arrested After Doing Doughnuts On Courthouse Lawn
